usefulness.rationale: The dossier body is empty; only three identity anchors (birth date/place, VINCI chairmanship since 2010, education) and one retained source (a news item about Pierre Anjolras's COO appointment) are present. A reader learns only the barest identity facts and nothing about Huillard's actual career actions, so understanding is minimal. No statements in the dossier assert more than their citations, so no overclaims can be identified — the three listed unjustified conclusions are pre-flagged hypotheses, not dossier claims with citations to assess. Conversation readiness is low: a reader could confirm who he is but could not prepare substantively for a meeting.
